t: A full-year AP Computer Science Principles course taught with the Snap! block language.
steps: Open the BJC site and read the teacher guide.
Open Snap! in a browser and try a first lab.
Download the Snap! source if you want offline use.
Decide whether students will use an optional account.
Plan the full-year schedule from the labs.
Look at the summer professional development workshops.
Preview the AI lecture videos before you assign them.
